d: Jharkhand ke dumka jile ke shikaripara thana kshetr ke badalpara kalyanpur ilake men prastavit kol blok ko lekar aayojit gram sabha ke dauran bhari baval ho gaya. koyla testing ke lie boring karane ke virodh men aakroshit graminon ne hariyana pavar jenreshan korporeshan limited (HPGCL) se boring ka tendar lene vali sinarji jiyo taig kanpni ke jiem sagar sinh mina ko bandhak bana liya aur berahmi se pitaee ke bad rat bhar apne kabje men rakha. vahin, graminon ke changul se jiem ko mukt karane ke lie dumka se bheje gae JAP aur RAF ke javanon par bhi ugr graminon ne hamla aur pattharbaji kar…
